_comment: SkyPatcher (D-3). Emits SKSE/Plugins/SkyPatcher/<recordType>/<file>.ini — in-memory runtime record edits by filter, no ESP override = zero conflict. Flat lines: filters (AND) first, then mods, colon-delimited. Requires SkyPatcher.dll at runtime; it resolves refs against the player's load order (ModForge only checks structure).

patches._comment: Give every Nord a magic-resist spell + a perk.
Tag NPCs that already have a keyword (keyword filter → keyword add).
Inject an item into a vanilla leveled list (no esp slot).
